label: Bible Study
verse: I and my Father are one.
note: Six words that nearly got Jesus stoned — the crowd picked up rocks in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Rejoicing in _____; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verse: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
note: Three quick habits from Paul: rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they brought the _____ to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
verse: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
note: The Palm Sunday ride: Mark calls it a colt, one that no man had ever sat on (Mark 11:2).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of _____;
verse: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
note: The Thessalonians feared they'd missed the day; Paul says a falling away and the man of sin come first.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is _____ to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verse: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
note: Why the delay? God is not 'slack' — he's 'longsuffering,' not willing that any should perish.
